job.purpose: CROWDLEG recorder sizing trial (Idea Desk C, owner MAIN): page count of the public trade tape over one fixed past 30 minute window (2026-09-20 18:00 to 18:30Z, a Sunday), to size a combo trade read. The reader counts pages, rows, and rows whose ticker starts with KXMVE; no price, size or side is read.
job.heldout: One fixed past window, 2026-09-20T18:00Z to 18:30Z, chosen before every held-out start found in HELDOUT_REGISTRY Table 2 (all on or after 2026-10-03). FOR AUDITOR B: the unfiltered tape holds trades of EVERY market traded in that half hour, which land on the public data branch; check that no card holds that half hour as held-out. The reader opens only the row count and the ticker prefix.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

job.notes: One request, the public trade list for min_ts 1789927200 to max_ts 1789929000, 1,000 a page, at most 50 pages. If it stops at 50 pages the count is a lower bound (at least 50,000 trades in 30 minutes) and is reported as truncated. Cap 55: 5 spare for 429 retries. The runner saves RAW answers: the unfiltered tape of that half hour (up to about 50,000 trades of every market) lands on the public kalshi-pull-data branch, not only the counts. It is public Kalshi data; size about 7 to 15 MB in all (Main's estimate), under the 5 MB answer cap per page and the 200 MB run cap. The cursor parameter is listed only because the runner's own paging requires it; no request sets it.
